title: Initiative Cohesion Playbook and Quarterly Runway Synchronizer
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Our company-level OKRs and supporting initiatives are periodically misaligned across teams because of differing sprint cadences, overlapping dependencies, and unclear decision ownership. This ticket defines a lightweight playbook and a quarterly runway synchronizer process to reduce rework, accelerate cross-team decisions, and keep initiative-level milestones aligned to outcome metrics.

Scope: 1) Define a compact template that maps each company OKR to 3–5 initiatives with clear success metrics, owners, and gating criteria. 2) Establish a recurring 6-week runway sync ritual that produces a single shared milestone map for the quarter. 3) Provide tooling/checklists for PMs and Eng leads to declare readiness, risks, and resource conflicts. 4) Integrate the output with the Console roadmap view and a Confluence template so work is discoverable and actionable.

Outcomes: - Reduce mid-quarter scope churn for company-level initiatives by 40% (target). - Surface cross-team blockers earlier (target mean time to discovery < 7 days). - Create a single source-of-truth artifact per OKR that engineering, product, and design can reference for rollouts and release gating.
acceptance_criteria: A one-page OKR->Initiative mapping template exists in Confluence and is used by at least 8 teams for the upcoming quarter
A documented 6-week runway sync ritual schedule and facilitator checklist is published
Integration: the artifact is linked to the Console roadmap for each initiative and appears in the per-model/per-route dashboard as ‘strategic context’
Two pilot OKRs complete the runway process during the next quarter and provide measurable before/after signals (scope churn, blocker lead time, and owner clarity)
